title: Sparkly bow tie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFE55C'>
    <!-- top left sparkle -->
    <path d='M20 18 L22 24 L28 26 L22 28 L20 34 L18 28 L12 26 L18 24 Z'/>
    <!-- top right sparkle -->
    <path d='M78 15 L80 21 L86 23 L80 25 L78 31 L76 25 L70 23 L76 21 Z'/>
    <!-- bottom left sparkle -->
    <path d='M15 70 L17 75 L22 77 L17 79 L15 84 L13 79 L8 77 L13 75 Z'/>
    <!-- bottom right sparkle -->
    <path d='M82 68 L84 73 L89 75 L84 77 L82 82 L80 77 L75 75 L80 73 Z'/>
    <!-- small sparkle top center -->
    <path d='M50 8 L51.5 12 L55.5 13.5 L51.5 15 L50 19 L48.5 15 L44.5 13.5 L48.5 12 Z'/>
    <!-- tiny dots -->
    <circle cx='32' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#FFD1E8'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='10' r='2' fill='#FFD1E8'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#FFD1E8'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='45' r='2' fill='#FFD1E8'/>
    <circle cx='12' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#FFF7A0'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='58' r='2.2' fill='#FFF7A0'/>
    <circle cx='35' cy='88' r='2' fill='#FFD1E8'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='90' r='2.5' fill='#FFD1E8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bow tie main shape -->
  <g>
    <!-- Left wing of bow -->
    <path d='M48 50 L22 32 L15 40 L15 60 L22 68 Z'
          fill='#E8365D' stroke='#FF7A9A' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <!-- Right wing of bow -->
    <path d='M52 50 L78 32 L85 40 L85 60 L78 68 Z'
          fill='#E8365D' stroke='#FF7A9A' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <!-- Left wing highlight -->
    <path d='M44 48 L26 36 L22 42 L34 50 Z' fill='#FF6B8E' opacity='0.8'/>
    <!-- Right wing highlight -->
    <path d='M56 48 L74 36 L78 42 L66 50 Z' fill='#FF6B8E' opacity='0.8'/>

    <!-- Center knot -->
    <rect x='44' y='42' width='12' height='16' rx='4' ry='4'
          fill='#C4214A' stroke='#E85078' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- Knot highlight -->
    <rect x='46' y='44' width='5' height='6' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#FF6B8E' opacity='0.7'/>

    <!-- Left wing inner fold line -->
    <path d='M42 50 L30 42' stroke='#B0173A' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- Right wing inner fold line -->
    <path d='M58 50 L70 42' stroke='#B0173A' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle shine on bow -->
  <g fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'>
    <path d='M25 38 L26 41 L29 42 L26 43 L25 46 L24 43 L21 42 L24 41 Z'/>
    <path d='M75 38 L76 41 L79 42 L76 43 L75 46 L74 43 L71 42 L74 41 Z'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='1.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
